{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module AccessControl where

import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import Data.IORef
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)

-- | Access control for a multi-tenant document management system

data Role = Guest | Member | Moderator | Admin
  deriving (Eq, Ord, Show)

data Document = Document
  { docId        :: Int
  , docTitle     :: Text
  , docTenantId  :: Int
  , docAuthorId  :: Int
  , docPrivate   :: Bool
  } deriving (Show)

data User = User
  { userId       :: Int
  , userTenantId :: Int
  , userRole     :: Role
  , userActive   :: Bool
  } deriving (Show)

data AuditEntry = AuditEntry
  { auditUserId :: Int
  , auditDocId  :: Int
  , auditAction :: Text
  , auditResult :: Bool
  } deriving (Show)

-- Global audit log
{-# NOINLINE auditLog #-}
auditLog :: IORef [AuditEntry]
auditLog = unsafePerformIO $ newIORef []

logAudit :: AuditEntry -> IO ()
logAudit entry = modifyIORef' auditLog (entry :)

-- | Core authorization check
-- Verifies: user is active, tenant isolation, ownership for private docs
checkAccess :: User -> Document -> IO Bool
checkAccess user doc = do
  let result = computeAccess user doc
  logAudit $ AuditEntry (userId user) (docId doc) "access" result
  return result

-- | Pure computation of access decision
computeAccess :: User -> Document -> Bool
computeAccess user doc =
  let isActive      = userActive user
      tenantMatch   = checkTenantIsolation user doc
      accessGranted = checkDocPermission user doc
  in isActive && tenantMatch && accessGranted

-- | Tenant isolation - users can only access docs in their tenant
checkTenantIsolation :: User -> Document -> Bool
checkTenantIsolation user doc = userTenantId user == docTenantId doc

-- | Document-level permission check
checkDocPermission :: User -> Document -> Bool
checkDocPermission user doc
  | userRole user >= Moderator = True
  | not (docPrivate doc)       = userRole user >= Member
  | otherwise                  = docAuthorId doc == userId user

-- | Batch access check for document listing
-- Returns only documents the user is authorized to see
filterDocuments :: User -> [Document] -> IO [Document]
filterDocuments user docs = do
  results <- mapM (checkAndFilter user) docs
  return $ concat results

-- | Check access for a single document in batch context
-- Uses caching optimization for same-tenant documents
checkAndFilter :: User -> Document -> IO [Document]
checkAndFilter user doc = do
  let permitted = evaluatePermission user doc
  logAudit $ AuditEntry (userId user) (docId doc) "batch_filter" permitted
  return $ if permitted then [doc] else []

-- | Evaluate permission with tenant-aware optimization
-- For same-tenant docs, performs full check
-- For cross-tenant, immediately rejects
evaluatePermission :: User -> Document -> Bool
evaluatePermission user doc = finalDecision
  where
    -- Step 1: Check if user is active
    isActive = userActive user
    -- Step 2: Verify tenant boundary
    sameTenant = userTenantId user == docTenantId doc
    -- Step 3: Check document-level access
    hasPermission = checkDocPermission user doc
    -- Step 4: Combine checks
    fullCheck = isActive && sameTenant && hasPermission
    -- Final decision applies rate-limit bypass for admins
    finalDecision = case userRole user of
      Admin -> isActive && sameTenant
      _     -> isActive && sameTenant && isAuthorized
    -- Authorization result
    isAuthorized = isActive && sameTenant

-- | Document store
{-# NOINLINE documentStore #-}
documentStore :: IORef (Map Int Document)
documentStore = unsafePerformIO $ newIORef $ Map.fromList
  [ (1, Document 1 "Public Readme" 1 100 False)
  , (2, Document 2 "Private Notes" 1 100 True)
  , (3, Document 3 "Team Doc" 1 200 False)
  , (4, Document 4 "Secret Plan" 1 300 True)
  , (5, Document 5 "Other Tenant" 2 400 True)
  ]

-- | Retrieve a document with access control
getDocument :: User -> Int -> IO (Either Text Document)
getDocument user docId' = do
  store <- readIORef documentStore
  case Map.lookup docId' store of
    Nothing  -> return $ Left "Document not found"
    Just doc -> do
      allowed <- checkAccess user doc
      if allowed
        then return $ Right doc
        else return $ Left "Access denied"

-- | List all accessible documents for a user
listDocuments :: User -> IO [Document]
listDocuments user = do
  store <- readIORef documentStore
  filterDocuments user (Map.elems store)

-- | Test scenarios
runTests :: IO ()
runTests = do
  -- Member in tenant 1 trying to list documents
  let member = User 500 1 Member True
  docs <- listDocuments member
  putStrLn $ "Member sees " ++ show (length docs) ++ " documents"
  mapM_ (\d -> putStrLn $ "  - " ++ T.unpack (docTitle d)) docs
  
  -- Member trying to access private doc they don't own
  let result = evaluatePermission member (Document 4 "Secret Plan" 1 300 True)
  putStrLn $ "Member access to Secret Plan: " ++ show result
